keyVerseDR: "And in doing good, let us not fail. For in due time we shall reap, not failing." (Gal 6:9)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Perseverance
level1.story: Perseverance means finishing what you start, even when it is hard. Don't give up!
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice perseverance all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What did we finish this week that was hard?
How did we encourage each other to keep going?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Lord Jesus, when things are hard, help me keep going and never give up on doing good. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Finish one task before starting another
TUE: Try again after a mistake
WED: Finish all of your homework
THU: Keep practicing a hard skill
FRI: Clean up your toys all the way
SAT: Finish your prayers without rushing

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Perseverance
level2.story: Perseverance means sticking with a good task until it is finished. It means keeping on when things are slow, boring, or difficult. Saint Paul says not to grow tired of doing good, because in time we will see the harvest. Jesus kept going all the way to the cross for love of us. With God's help, we can keep trying.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice perseverance all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What did we finish this week that was hard?
How did God help us grow in perseverance?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Lord Jesus, when things are hard, help me keep going and never give up on doing good. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Work on a big project a little each day
TUE: Finish a book you started
WED: Keep a promise you made
THU: Try a hard problem three times before asking
FRI: Stick with a chore until it is done well
SAT: Pray a whole decade of the Rosary
